title: Refactor UI components to modern frameworks
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 forms need to be refactored to a modern UI framework to improve maintainability and user experience.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated UI components will lead to increased maintenance costs and potential security risks.
suggested_approach: Migrate forms to a modern web-based UI framework like React or Angular.
success_criteria: All forms are accessible via a web interface.
UI components follow modern design principles.
